No archives were actually restored.

minor.issue: Platform credit adjustments write credit_transactions with user_id=target.id, but /api/wallet queries by workspace_id(user)=owner_id. For sub-users (e.g., budi belongs to demo's workspace), the 'adjustment' transaction is invisible in the user's own /wallet. Admin's adjust also changes users.credits (per-user) which is not the balance consumed by record_usage (which uses the workspace owner's credits). Suggest either (a) always posting adjustments against workspace owner id, or (b) also crediting workspace owner balance, or (c) documenting the two-tier model explicitly.

ui_bugs.issue: For '/platform' the testid was 'pnav-platform' instead of expected 'pnav-dashboard' (split('/').pop() returned 'platform'). Patched to use 'pnav-dashboard' when n.end is true.

issues: Console warning: Recharts complains 'width(-1) height(-1) ... please check the style of container' on first paint (chart renders fine after reflow). Harmless but noisy.

action_items: Decide the intended behavior for platform credit adjustments on sub-users: /api/wallet does not show them because transactions are keyed by user_id, not workspace_id. Also decide whether users.credits (per-user) or workspace owner credits should move.
Optional: silence Recharts width/height warning on PlatformDashboard by giving the ResponsiveContainer parent a fixed min-height or deferring render until layout settles.
critical_code_review_comments: platform_admin.disable_user: once disabled, existing JWT returns 401 on /api/auth/me (good) but the token itself is still valid cryptographically; without a token blacklist a disabled user could keep calling cached endpoints that don't go through user_from_token. All critical endpoints DO use current_user => require re-fetch, so it's fine, but worth noting.

platform_admin.add_staff: generates a random password_hash (new_id()+new_id()) for new staff. If reset email isn't delivered (SMTP) and EMAIL_DEBUG_LINKS is false in prod, the admin has no way to resend the reset link from the UI. Consider adding a 'Resend set-password link' action on the staff row.
PlatformApp testid used '/platform' path's last segment, which collapsed to 'platform' not 'dashboard'. Patched. Look for similar fragile derive-from-path patterns in other back-office nav lists.

chat.CORE_CHARACTER is injected server-side via replace() of placeholders in the system prompt - cannot be verified by API shape alone. Confirmed presence of the constant and injection site in chat.py; not asserted in integration tests.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 finance staff users during test runs (finance-test-<rand>, finance-fe-<rand>). All revoked (platform_role removed) at the end; the user rows remain but have no platform access. budi credits/disabled state restored (credits=50, disabled=false).

Login throttle is aggressive (10 attempts/5 min per IP+email) - avoid long parallel UI test loops.
rca of the issue: Platform wallet-visibility bug (minor): credit_transactions row inserted on adjust has user_id=target user's own id, but /api/wallet uses workspace_id (owner_id). For sub-users this hides the adjustment from the user's wallet UI. Reproduce: login admin -> POST /api/platform/users/{budi_id}/credits {delta:50} -> login budi -> GET /api/wallet.transactions => no 'adjustment' row. Mitigation options: write with user_id=workspace_id(target), or also credit workspace owner, or document the two-tier credit model.
